features.label: BOM image extraction
limitations: Synthetic renderings of ruling-derived illustrative fixtures, not real photos, handwriting or independent customs cases. The original primary rulings were not newly reread for this image study.
Related documents share source components and layouts. Source families are disjoint across development and reserved test; eight rendering styles are shared, four are test-only.
Names use exact case/whitespace-normalized matching, not a model judge. Country aliases use a fixed map. Semantically equivalent paraphrases can therefore fail.

Whole-document agreement requires all expected confirmed parts and countries, no extra confirmed parts, and a warning plus no invented country for every missing-origin part. The production API withholds missing-country rows from confirmed components.
The language variation changes column headers only; the component names remain as in the English source fixtures.
The missing-origin footer explicitly says the supplier address is not a statement of part origin. Withholding11/11 is on a self-labelled distractor in one layout, not an unlabelled-address challenge.
The bundled font can leave a visible glyph gap before the closing parenthesis. The strict scorer still treats the model's inserted space as a mismatch, not a legal or wrong-origin error.

All three reserved mismatches are an extra space before a closing parenthesis in the PCBA name; the three extracted rows are unmatched names, not independently established invented parts. Strict first scores remain unchanged.
features.public_note: 52/132 sheets have only 1–2 parts; 21/24 sheets with 12+ parts matched.
